images.title: Every look in one gallery
images.description: Combine a skin, model, cape or elytra, and outer layers into complete looks, then switch between them with a single click
images.alt: The NCL Skins My Looks gallery with several saved looks, one active look, and actions on each card

images.title: See skin compatibility at a glance
images.description: Badges show support for Ears, Fresh Moves, and Just Expressions and warn you about conflicts with active mods and resource packs
images.alt: The NCL Skins look editor with an Ears skin preview, an incompatibility warning, and an open compatibility tooltip

images.title: Build your look with a live preview
images.description: Choose a Classic or Slim model, cape or elytra, and outer layers, then see the combined result from Ears, 3D Skin Layers, Fresh Moves, and Just Expressions in game
images.alt: The NCL Skins look editor with a large player preview, cape selection, outer-layer controls, and a skin compatibility badge

images.title: Explore entire skin collections
images.description: Browse standard Minecraft characters, skins from Mojang events, and collections from active resource packs using search and model filters
images.alt: The NCL Skins Catalog showing the Standard collection, search, the Slim model filter, and the control for collapsing or expanding every section

images.title: Import skins your way
images.description: Add PNG files or direct links, look up a skin by player name or UUID, and bring over looks from launchers and other mods
images.alt: The NCL Skins import screen with file upload, player name or UUID lookup, a direct link, and options for importing looks from other apps

images.title: Review everything before importing
images.description: Separate new looks from duplicates, check skin compatibility, and select only what you want to add to your library
images.alt: The NCL Skins import review screen with groups of new and duplicate looks, selected cards, and compatibility badges

images.title: Open your gallery right from Minecraft
images.description: Click your player preview in the main or pause menu to open My Looks without a separate launcher or website
images.alt: The Minecraft pause menu with an integrated preview of the current player that opens the NCL Skins gallery

images.title: Keep using your gallery offline
images.description: Create, edit, and apply looks locally even when Minecraft services are unavailable, then sync your official appearance later
images.alt: The NCL Skins My Looks gallery in Offline mode with local look actions still available
